steps.content: You venture out deeper and deeper alone. You've lost count of how many battles you've experienced, dodging contamination and Mutant Bugs. Now, you are lost in the distorted chaos. You don't know when you fell down, or how long it's been.
When your consciousness returns, you feel as if you're floating in the air or on the sea, bobbing up and down.
...Didn't we agree that you'd wait for me back there? What would I do if something happened to you, too...
You struggle to open your eyes and roughly make out the person talking to you.
"Mantis" is carrying you through the twisted forest, returning to the shelter that had just been attacked. The scholar walks steadily, with strength that does not match her figure.
The female rescuer who just lost her husband is also back. She is still in a coma, but the wounds on her body have been properly treated.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: You're the last one. I've saved all the people I can.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Now, you must leave Mantis territory. You can't stop even for a moment.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I'm going to the bug nest to bring back the people who were captured.

options: There's no way we're letting you go alone!

steps.content: "Mantis" smiles, opens the car door and puts you in the driver's seat, then starts to treat your wounds.
Yet she is one who clearly has more contamination and wounds. The scholar still has a faint smile on her lips, but her eyes are somewhat hollow. She begins to whisper softly.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: My guess was correct. The Mutant Bugs are interested in "human wisdom and behavior," particularly "group sentiment."

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: They keep repairing themselves at astonishing speeds, and now they are using human relationships and feelings to set traps. Their understanding of human nature is progressing too fast... way too fast...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I was too naive. Because they crave the human heart, I unconsciously got close to them mentally, hoping that they could be communicable peers. Ha...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: There are clearly more ways in nature to acquire intelligence, and more ways to repair... It's my fault that a naturalist like me was so unimaginative...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...There's no time. They could die at any time while waiting for rescue. Now the only one who can act is me...

options: It's too dangerous. If you go, you'll also just...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Don't underestimate me. I just single-handedly saved you from a swarm of Mutant Bugs. You missed quite the exciting battle while you were passed out.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I'm the one who knows them best. While researching how to fight them, I also gained some power. I can also occasionally understand their communications. Only I can do this.
You remember what she looked like when you first saw her: covered in spikes and with prominent signs of mutation... You thought that was just from the illusion, but now it seems that's not the case.

options: You may have been contaminated by Mania.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: "Mania"... what's that? The abnormal radiation of the Perishing Star? Sounds like a pretty good name. Keylan would definitely like it.
Her giggly optimism might be infectious to many, but now it feels like a fishbone stuck in your throat.

options: I'm going with you. You can't venture out alone.

steps.content: An uncomfortable silence ensues. After a while, she finally speaks, but dodges your question.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: You said that after getting out, you want to shoot the fifth season of "Wilderness Trek" with me...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I'm sorry. That show has been permanently canceled. The fourth season ended halfway during the production.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: The production crew, my most precious companions, have already gone to another world. They died on the journey of exploring the apocalypse. I joined the expedition team on their behalf to continue our journey.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I believe in my wild conjectures. I believe that their spirits still exist in this world, perhaps inside an apostle we don't understand yet. I believe that I will eventually find them...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: But I really don't want you to meet the same fate.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I know that humanity needs a great superhero scholar, but... this superhero is a bit selfish. She needs you. I don't want to lose any more companions. Not a single one.

options: ...I can fight too. I'll go with you.

steps.content: You want to prove it to her with your shackles, but "Mantis" gently takes your hand.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I know. It feels different carrying you now.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: You've gotten heavier and taller, kid. So much taller...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: You are no longer the kid we knew, right?

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I'm not "Mantis," but I'm sure you don't remember my real name.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: It's okay. I'm glad you stumbled back here, back to me.
She tightens her grip on your hand.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...Our little guide has become more mature, braver, and smarter. You've become more powerful, kinder, and better at taking care of everyone.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: We used to take care of you, but now you've grown up, and we can depend on you.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I can only temporarily repel the Mutant Bugs, but this is still their territory. They'll be back soon. If you have the power and really want to help me... then protect my companions on my behalf.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Take them back to the camp, and find Keylan's stone slate. You know the way. Everyone is waiting for you there. You won't be lost.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Even if you don't remember, you can hear where your heart wants to lead you.
She smiles, reaching out to gently touch your earring.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Once you find the stone slate, use it to return to your own era safely.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: This is not your era, nor where you ought to be. You have real companions to worry about, and more important things to do.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Don't forget the way back.
You are speechless. It takes you a while to respond.

options: ...I promise you, I'll definitely get them back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I don't want to leave just like that. I'll wait for you at the stone slate. If you don't come back, I'll come find you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if I don't belong here, even if I'm destined to leave... I want you to see me off. I want to leave on happy terms. That's not too much to ask for, is it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Aren't we companions?

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...Of course we are.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: No matter where or when, or what we turn into... you will always be my companion.

The car starts, and you look back at her. Mantis stays in place, watching you. Before she disappears into the thick fog, her silhouette subtly starts to change. You can't see her face, and you don't know what happened.
...You only know that now she is alone.
